title: The bar
notices: Scenario one opens. Level 1, goal GTM Engineer roles.

recorded.text: Hey Sanjay, I'm Navid. I'll be your coach from here.
Jay runs this project; I'm on your side.
I'll help you get to GTM Engineer roles faster,
and I'll only speak up when it matters.
Three things decide your grade here.
Your notes, how you update Jay, and whether you test before you send.
Nail those, and this one is exceptional.

new.text: Hey Sanjay, I'm Navid. I'm your coach, not your answer key.
When I step in, it's one question, and the answer is yours to find.
Three things decide your grade here.
Your notes, your updates to Jay, and testing before you send.
Which of those three do you usually skip?
